templates.neutral: engage in a variety of sports and games that promote physical fitness and teamwork. They organize competitions that allow individuals to showcase their skills and build camaraderie. In recreational activities, they emphasize the importance of fair play and mutual respect among participants. Their children are encouraged to join in these activities from a young age, fostering a love for movement and healthy competition
templates.animalistic: infest arenas with their energy and instinctual drive for dominance in sports and games. They overrun fields during competitions, displaying their prowess and asserting their place within the hierarchy. In physical recreation, they signal to one another through vocalizations and movements that reflect their pack dynamics. They rear their young in an environment rich with competitive play, ensuring that the next generation is primed for survival and success
templates.mechanistic: are integrated into structured systems of sports and games that prioritize efficiency and performance. They are allocated to competitive events where their skills are measured against established benchmarks. In physical recreation, they transmit data on performance metrics and participant statistics for analysis. Their juveniles are processed through development pipelines that emphasize skill acquisition and competitive readiness
